// note: How the tier diff reads a value. 'secret' values never leave the process. 'infra' values (urls, hosts, ports) are expected to differ between tiers, which are separate deployments - without this classification the grid reports that difference as drift. 'business' values (bank codes, terminal ids, provider keys, timeouts, flags) are expected to be IDENTICAL everywhere; a mismatch there is a real finding.

rules.// note: Also catches PaymentSettings:Encryption:Profile:Key, which the root-anchored rule above misses. Leaving it uncovered rendered a live encryption key in the grid.
'except' vetoes a match. Needed because a Couchbase scope set is literally named 'token' and would otherwise be masked as a credential.
RsaKeyPem and anything else holding inline key material.

A per-institution lookup table - codes, terminal ids, routing numbers - is reference data every tier should agree on, so it stays business even where a key name below would otherwise read it as infra.
